triggers.desc: One area per `enum` value, the areas come from `options.areas`.
One area per `oneOf` entry, its `area` key is the shape (`rules.visible` on an entry hides it).
Multiple choices, the data is an array.

image.desc: The image: a URL, or `{ src, width, height }` with its natural size in pixels (read from the loaded image otherwise). JPEG, PNG and WebP, as an http(s) or relative URL or a data URI.

areas.desc: Area of each value, keyed by value: `{ shape, coords }`. Wins over the `area` of the `oneOf` entry.

area.desc: On a `oneOf` entry or an `areas` entry: `shape` is `rect`, `circle` or `poly`, `coords` are `x1, y1, x2, y2` / `cx, cy, r` / `x1, y1, x2, y2, ...` in the pixels of the image, as an array of numbers or a comma separated string (the HTML `<area>` convention).

select.desc: Show a select of the same values under the image, in sync with the areas; the other options (`dense`, `outlined`...) are passed to it. Without it, the error and the hint are displayed under the image.

maxWidth.desc: Maximum width of the image, in px when a number; the image otherwise fills its container.

color.desc: Quasar color of the hovered and selected areas.

outline.desc: Outline all the areas, not only the hovered and selected ones.

data.desc: The selected value, or an array of values for a multiple choice (an empty array when nothing is selected). A second click clears an optional single choice; once `maxItems` values are selected, the other areas are disabled. Read-only, the selection is displayed but ignores clicks; a hidden control (`rules.visible`) loses its value, a value that is no longer an entry is cleared. The areas are focusable, Space or Enter toggles them.

required.desc: A required single choice with no value (AJV).

minItems.desc: Lower bound of a multiple choice (AJV).

maxItems.desc: Upper bound of a multiple choice (AJV); the renderer also disables the other areas once it is reached.
